GOOD TO KNOW

Quick answers.

Everything you need before you start.

Do I need a new account?

No. Use the same Secret J account you use for Job Hunter.

Can recruiters open my portfolio without an account?

Yes. Anyone with a published portfolio link can chat with it.

Can I choose what information is shared?

Yes. Review your information before creating a draft and publish only when ready. You can unpublish or delete your portfolio.

Will the AI always be accurate?

Answers are based on your reviewed professional information, but AI can make mistakes.
